features.name: Draconic Affiliation
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, choose one dragon affiliation:

| Dragon | Associated Skill | Damage Type |
|---|---|---|
| Black or Copper | Stealth | Acid |
| Blue or Bronze | Insight | Lightning |
| Brass, Gold, or Red | Intimidation | Fire |
| Green | Deception | Poison |
| Silver or White | History | Cold |

You gain proficiency in the dragon's associated skill (doubled if already proficient) and resistance to the listed damage type.

features.name: Draconic Onslaught
features.description: At 3rd level, when you use Step of the Wind then hit with an attack on the same turn, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage of the type associated with your Draconic Affiliation.

features.name: Take Flight
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you take the Dash action, spend 1 ki to gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn. While flying, a creature that hits you with an opportunity attack takes 2d6 damage of your Draconic Affiliation type.

features.name: Conquering Wyrm
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, when you take the Attack action after using Step of the Wind in the same turn, spend 2 additional ki to replace your first attack with one unarmed strike against each creature within 5 ft of your end-of-movement space. Hit: extra 4d6 of your Draconic Affiliation damage type. Can't use this and Draconic Onslaught in the same round.

features.name: Scales of the Wyrm
features.description: At 17th level, spend 4 ki on your turn to gain for 10 minutes: +2 AC, temporary HP equal to monk level, immunity to frightened. While active, when you take your Draconic Affiliation damage type, use your reaction to reduce that damage to 0.
